description: This file defines a readonly struct 'StateMachineStorageWriter' that provides various methods to append entries to a log segment, identified by a 'StateMachineId'. It acts as a writer utility for state machine storage in the Orleans.Journaling namespace.

classes.name: StateMachineStorageWriter
classes.description: A readonly struct that provides methods to append different types of byte sequences and actions to a log segment associated with a specific state machine ID.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Overloaded methods to append various byte sequence types or an action with a value to the log segment.
